title: Recall Quiz: Meaning & Scope of PE

questions.q: Who defined Physical Education as 'the sum of changes in the individual caused by experiences centering in motor activity'?
questions.qPa: ਕਿਸਨੇ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਨੂੰ 'ਮੋਟਰ ਗਤੀਵਿਧੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੇਂਦਰਿਤ ਅਨੁਭਵਾਂ ਕਾਰਨ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਤਬਦੀਲੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਜੋੜ' ਵਜੋਂ ਪਰਿਭਾਸ਼ਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Rosalind Cassidy's definition focuses on the 'sum of changes' resulting from 'motor activity'.

questions.q: Which of the following best describes the modern concept of Physical Education?
questions.qPa: ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਆਧੁਨਿਕ ਸੰਕਲਪ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਵਰਣਨ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Modern PE views the human as a unified whole and aims for holistic (physical, mental, social) development.

questions.q: The phrase 'big muscle activities and their related responses' is strongly associated with the definition given by:
questions.explanation: Voltmer and Esslinger defined PE as the phase dealing with 'big muscle activities'.

questions.q: According to H. Clark, which of the following is NOT an objective of Physical Education?
questions.explanation: H. Clark's three objectives are Physical Fitness, Social Efficiency, and Culture. Economic Independence is not one.

questions.q: What is the primary difference between Physical Training (PT) and Physical Education (PE)?
options: PT uses equipment, PE does not
PT focuses only on physical fitness, PE focuses on holistic development
PT is for adults, PE is for children
questions.explanation: PT is narrowly focused on bodily fitness and discipline, while PE uses physical activity to educate the whole person.

questions.q: The ultimate aim of Physical Education is:
questions.qPa: ਸਰੀਰਕ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਅੰਤਮ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The ultimate aim is always the wholesome or total development of the individual to live a happy, vigorous life.

questions.q: Learning teamwork and sportsmanship falls under which objective?
questions.explanation: Interacting with others, cooperation, and sportsmanship are part of Social Efficiency.

questions.q: Which scholar's definition is very similar to Voltmer's but often emphasizes psychological 'responses'?
questions.explanation: J.B. Nash also uses 'big muscle activities' but expands slightly on the psychological and related responses.
